description: Enforced field set, enums, and channel vocabulary for a host-neutral, evidence-bound field-change record. Single source read by scripts/validate_field_change.py; the prose field-change-record.schema.md documents intent and rules and does not restate these lists. Procedural rules (action_ref, boundary, target_effect non-empty; field_channels non-empty and drawn from the channel vocabulary; field_effect OBSERVED requires a wake_ref; no VERIFIED assurance) stay in the validator. Adapts FRR v0.4's Residual-Location and Field-Change pass (state vs. field persistence) to the FRR system's enforced-record model.
